answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Nobody is waved through free: a 7-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one is the price, and the mirror never covers it twice. The manifest lists a name once it holds Embossed oculist guild charter, and a charter oculists hold after eye inspections is the entry the clerk looks for. The sonnet is checked, not assumed. The velvet is on the docket.
